component.name: Open Paint Studio
component.summary: Sketch, mark up and edit images, with shapes and text kept editable

description.p: This is a community package of Open Paint Studio, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the OpenAEC Foundation. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

Open Paint Studio is a small image editor in the spirit of MS Paint. Draw with a brush, eraser, fill, eyedropper, lines, rectangles, ellipses and text typed straight onto the canvas; crop, resize, rotate and flip; adjust brightness, contrast and colour. With "Keep vector objects" on, shapes and text stay selectable and editable afterwards and can be exported as editable SVG.

It opens PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, HEIC, AVIF, PSD, SVG, JPEG XL, camera RAW and more, decoded locally by a bundled ImageMagick WebAssembly build, and exports PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG and IFCX. The interface opens in Dutch; English is one click away in Settings.
Sandbox: display and GPU only. Files are opened and saved through the file chooser, and nothing goes over the network. Updates come through FlatPark.

The Automation tab can push the image to upstream's REST API service, a separate Node program on 127.0.0.1:47831 that is not part of this app. If you run that service, allow the connection with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Connect to the local API: flatpak override --user --share=network org.openaec.OpenPaintStudio
